_doc: Item Workshop (hdart/puppet_items.py): equipment as overlay layers on the race's painted puppet, one layer per Template part it covers. zones: where an item may sit, as data (an editor comes later): part (fnmatch, e.g. arm*.upper), t = [from, to] along the part's bone (0 = start joint, 1 = end joint; <= 0 / >= 1 include the round ends), rows = [from, to] as fractions of the part's height (head, torso), ellipse = [cx, cy, rx, ry] as fractions of the part's box (curved edges), view = front / back (a zone for one view only), seam = above_waist / below_waist (+ seam_px to move the line down). bulk = px (1024 canvas) the item may paint beyond those zones. depth = stacking order (higher draws over lower). materials = colour keys the item is painted in; each becomes a channel (G of the levels map) coloured by a ramp of that material's palette group. clips = layers this item cuts away where it covers them (hair). kind held = generated alone on white and attached to a hand (grip), not painted on the body.
prompt: {style}. One {body}, full body, three-quarter view facing left, seen slightly from above, standing in an A-pose, now wearing {item}. {materials} Clean dark outlines; the same face, head, skin and body, nothing else added. On a pure white background.
prompt_back: {style}. The same {body} seen from behind, three-quarter back view facing away to the right, seen slightly from above, standing in an A-pose, wearing {item}: the same item as in the reference image, now from behind. {materials} Clean dark outlines, on a pure white background.
prompt_held: {style}. A single {item} on its own, upright and vertical, pointing straight up, the handle at the bottom, seen from the side, centred, game item art. {materials} Clean dark outlines, on a pure white background.
material_text: The {name} parts are one flat vivid pure {word} colour (a colour key), shaded only with darker and lighter {word}.

item.trousers.text: simple loose cloth trousers reaching down to the mid shin

item.boots.text: sturdy leather boots up to the mid shin

item.tunic.text: a simple cloth tunic with sleeves to the mid forearm and a hem at the hips

item.pauldrons.text: rounded steel plate pauldrons on both shoulders

item.helm.text: an open-faced round steel helmet covering the top of the head and the forehead

item.sword.text: short steel sword with a simple crossguard and a leather-wrapped grip
